full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Abdul Matin, J.:- This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 13.02.2007 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.4941 of 1998 discharging the Rule and affirming the judgment and order dated 14.07.1998 passed by the learned District Judge, Gazipur in Miscellaneous Case No.13 of 1996 rejecting an application under Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for recalling the order dated 15.07.1997 dismissing the Miscellaneous Case No.13 of 1996 under Order 41, Rule 19 of the Code of Civil Procedure. 

 4. Thereafter the plaintiff petitioner (predecessor of present petitioners) filed Miscellaneous Case No.13 of 1996 under order 41, Rule 19 of the Code of Civil Procedure in the court of the learned District Judge, Gazipur. The learned District Judge, after hearing both the parties was pleased to allow the Miscellaneous Case No.13 of 1996 on 26.04.1997 on contest with C.P. cost of Tk.3,000/- to be paid by the plaintiff petitioner to the defendant opposite parties by 02.06.1997. On 02.06.1997 the plaintiff petitioner filed an application praying for time to deposit the C.P. cost of Tk.3,000/- in court on the ground of economic crisis whereupon the learned District Judge was pleased to grant time on 30.06.1997 when the plaintiff petitioner deposited Tk.500/- under receipt No.475 dated 30.06.1997 as part payment of C.P. cost of Tk.3,000/- with prayer for 15 days time to deposit the balance cost when the learned District Judge, was pleased to grant time upto 15.07.1997 to deposit the same failing which the said Miscellaneous Case would stand dismissed. 

 5. On the date fixed on 15.07.1997 plaintiff petitioner deposited Tk.1,000/- as C.P. cost under receipt No.25 dated 15.07.1997. He also filed a verified petition praying for 15 days time to deposit the balance cost of Tk.1,500/- but the learned District Judge was pleased to reject the petition for time and directed the plaintiff petitioner to deposit the balance cost of Tk.1,500/- before 4.30 P.M. on 15.07.1997. The plaintiff petitioner having failed to deposit the same in such a short span of time had no other alternative but to apply once more for time to deposit the rest of the C.P. cost but the clerk of the learned District Judge, refused to receive such petition. Ultimately the learned District Judge was pleased to dismiss the Miscellaneous Case in question. 

 6. On 30.10.1997 the defendant opposite party prayed for withdrawal of deposited C.P. cost of Tk.1,500/- which was rejected on 26.11.1997 by the learned District Judge. In the meantime the plaintiff petitioner fell ill. He was under medical treatment of Dr. professor Abdullah Harun of P.G. Hospital with effect from 16.07.1997 to 27.06.1998 and as such, could not take step in the matter. In this state of affirms he managed to procure Tk.1,500/- with great difficulty and deposited the same in court on 29.06.1998 under receipt No.532 and filed an application with medical certificate praying for accepting the balance of C.P. cost and for recalling order dated 15.07.1997 and to restore order dated 26.04.1997. The said application was fixed for hearing on 14.07.1998. The said application dated 29.06.1998 when came up for hearing, the learned District Judge, was pleased to reject the same on the ground, that the Miscellaneous Case was dismissed for non-payment of C.P. cost and thus, there was no scope for restoration of the appeal to its original file and number by his order dated 15.07.1998. 

 9. It appears that the High Court Division considered that although the learned District Judge extended time the plaintiff petitioner failed repeatedly to deposit cost as directed by him and in that event the learned District Judge rightly dismissed the Miscellaneous Case, in default, of payment of C.P. cost.
